business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Physical Vessel Shipment of VHP Raw Cane Centrifugal Sugar

stage_1.expense_line_item: Corporate Name Search, Email Confirmation, and 30-Day Name Reservation
stage_1.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (operated via International Registries, Inc.)
stage_1.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per RMI Registrar's Fee Schedule applicable to the Business Corporations Act

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), RMI Revised Code Title 51, as amended; applicable Sections 31–37 (incorporation), Section 33 (capitalization), Section 53 (registered office and registered agent), and Sections 60–80 (directors and officers); Foreign Investment Business Act of 2016 for foreign ownership registration if on-island activity is later conducted.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro, MH (filings administered through licensed RMI registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation) filed under RMI Business Corporations Act Section 36.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under RMI BCA Section 33; capital may be fixed by the board, and shares may be issued for lawful consideration not less than par value; no escrow or capital deposit requirement applicable to a non-resident Business Corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription for 1,000 shares of no par value Common Stock and that the Secretary issue Share Certificate No. 1 upon receipt of lawful consideration not less than one US cent per share. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office shall be at the office of the Registered Agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the Registered Agent is authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed President and [Name] is appointed Secretary-Treasurer, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute voyage charter and sugar sale/purchase contracts, and file all government returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI (via licensed RMI registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed RMI registered agent and instruct a name search to confirm the proposed corporate name is available and distinguishable. Submit a name reservation request with alternate names. The registered agent will issue a consent to act and confirm the Majuro registered office address.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and two alternates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar, file a written request for administrative reconsideration within 10 business days or promptly submit an alternate available name with the agent's amended consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and notary public / RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator executes the Articles of Incorporation, stating corporate name, share class, authorized capital, registered office address, registered agent name, and the broad purpose of wholesale trading and vessel shipment of raw cane sugar. The registered agent countersigns the consent to act as agent and registered office.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Duly completed Form under RMI BCA Section 36
Registered Agent consent and acceptance of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any defect, the incorporator may file an amendment or corrected Articles within 30 days of the Notice of Deficiency; no additional fee is charged if corrected within that period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with Registrar and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, RMI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Articles and the USD 250 state fee to the Registrar by electronic transmission or courier. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the corporation comes into existence as of the filing date. The certified certificate is returned to the registered agent's office.
required_dossiers: Payment of USD 250 official filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, the registered agent may file an Application for Endorsement or Corrective Filing within 30 days; if the Registrar has misapplied the law, appeal is available to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Share Issuance and Officer Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole incorporator or initial board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial director(s) adopt the Organization Consent in lieu of the organizational meeting, approve the By-Laws, accept the 1,000 common share subscription, cause Share Certificate No. 1 to be issued, and appoint the President and Secretary-Treasurer. The adoption of the first board resolution occurs immediately after incorporation.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution / Unanimous Written Consent of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural defect in the organizational consent may be cured by a subsequent unanimous written consent of directors ratifying all prior acts and share issuances nunc pro tunc.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Facilities and Banking Account Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI licensed financial institution and RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the public corporate record updates and obtains a certified Certificate of Good Standing. The President opens a corporate bank account in a RMI-licensed international bank, submitting the incorporation certificate, board resolution, and economic substance declaration (if requested). No RMI business license is required for a non-resident offshore trading corporation transacting outside the RMI.
required_dossiers: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
First Board Resolution authorizing bank account opening
Passport copies of directors and officers
Corporate banking application and reference letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the corporate record, submit an updated board resolution and certified good standing certificate; if the bank demands a business license, obtain a Foreign Investment Business License Certificate under the Foreign Investment Business Act on the basis of non-resident trading activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — wholesale trading of raw cane sugar (ISIC 4631 / NAICS 424490) is not a regulated industrial activity in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; no Ministry of Industrial licensing required for non-resident trading entities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — non-resident Business Corporation does not hold an RMI trading license for off-island commodity arbitrage and vessel shipment; no local premises or manufacturing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — commercial office/trading activities fall outside Schedule 2 of the RMI Environmental Protection Act 1984; no EIA study or environmental permit mandated for offshore wholesale sugar trading.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to registered office trading activity. If chartered vessels call at RMI ports, compliance applies under the RMI Maritime Act 1990 and MARPOL Annexes I, IV and V for oil, sewage, garbage and ballast water; no stationary emissions source or on-island wastewater discharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — the corporation maintains no physical industrial premises or employees in the RMI; registered office only. Should warehousing or office space be established later, the Majuro Fire Department building safety inspection, National Building Code certificate of occupancy, and workplace health and safety clearance would be required prior to commencement of on-island operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division (RTD), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); corporate registry and taxpayer administration are coordinated through licensed registered agents, the RMI Registrar of Corporations (www.rmicorporation.org), and the RTD taxpayer portal (www.rmi-tax.gov.mh).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign incorporators appoint a licensed RMI registered agent; file Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCA) to obtain a Certificate of Incorporation; the agent then files a non-resident domestic corporation declaration (Business License Act exemption form) with the Registrar of Corporations and applies to the RTD for a Tax Identification Number (TIN). The RTD issues the TIN within 5-10 business days. No VAT ID exists in the RMI because no VAT system is in force. A non-resident corporation with zero RMI-source gross revenue is not required to maintain RMI payroll or transfer pricing files and files only a nil BPT return (or zero-liability declaration) annually.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. A non-resident domestic Business Corporation is an entity-level taxable person for Business Privilege Tax (BPT) purposes only if it engages in business within the RMI; where wholesale raw cane sugar trading and vessel shipment occur entirely offshore, the BC is statutorily tax-exempt: zero income tax, zero BPT, zero withholding tax, zero gross receipts tax, and zero capital gains tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under BCA sections 103-104, a Business Corporation may elect 'non-resident domestic' status by filing a certified declaration with the Registrar of Corporations and the RTD through its registered agent, confirming that no business is transacted in the RMI and no income is derived from RMI sources. This binary election (resident vs. non-resident) is the exclusive classification mechanism; no US-style check-the-box, no hybrid mismatch elections, no treaty-based branch elections, and no flow-through elections are recognized, and the RMI maintains no income tax treaty network.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales-and-Use Tax. The only indirect levies are the Business Privilege Tax (gross receipts tax on RMI-source activity) and the Traders' Tax (customs import duty and services gross receipts tax); both are inapplicable to offshore sugar commodity arbitrage executed by a non-resident domestic BC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD 0; there is no de minimis turnover threshold. Any gross revenue derived from within the RMI triggers BPT registration and taxation (statutory BPT rates: 3% on the first USD 500,000 of RMI-source gross revenue, 5% on the next USD 500,000, and 7% above USD 1,000,000). A non-resident domestic BC engaged exclusively in offshore sugar shipments crosses no threshold and holds tax-exempt zero-liability status.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI imposes no electronic invoicing mandate, no real-time fiscal clearance, no government API clearance, and no digital stamping regime. BPT taxpayers may retain paper or electronic records for at least three years. Export transactions are evidenced by the origin country's customs electronic declarations (e.g., Brazil SISCOMEX or Thailand e-Customs) and commercial shipping documents, not by RMI fiscal invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a VAT concept: the RMI does not impose VAT, so there is no 0% export VAT rate, no export VAT refund, and no input-credit mechanism. Instead, export and offshore revenue is categorically excluded from the BPT base for a non-resident domestic BC under the BCA and BPT Act source rules. Eligibility for the zero-liability classification requires: (i) a valid non-resident domestic declaration on file; (ii) no physical office, employees, or inventory in the RMI; (iii) the sugar cargo never enters RMI customs territory; and (iv) title and risk pass on FOB/CIF/CIF-FO terms outside RMI waters under a revolving letter of credit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: RMI Certificate of Incorporation and non-resident domestic corporation declaration (BCA sections 103-104)
Negotiable Ocean Bill of Lading issued to the order of the LC issuing bank evidencing shipment on an RMI-flagged or chartered vessel
Carrier Cargo Manifest and the origin country's Customs Export Declaration (e.g., Brazil SISCOMEX or Thailand e-Customs)
Commercial Invoice and Packing List for VHP raw cane centrifugal sugar (INCOTERMS FOB/CIF)
Certificate of Origin issued by the origin country chamber of commerce
SGS or CIQ-licensed Certificate of Quality, Weight, and Polarization (ICUMSA-polarization assay)
Inward Remittance Certificate or LC settlement advice from the negotiating bank evidencing USD inflow
Vessel Store Certificate and flag-state (RMI) endorsement confirming cargo was not discharged into RMI customs territory
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: RMI audit exposure is minimal for a properly classified non-resident BC. However, the RTD may audit nil BPT filings where misclassification is suspected (e.g., substantive board meetings in Majuro, RMI office used for decision-making, or shipping documentation showing discharge into RMI ports). Consequences of wrongful zero-liability filing include: (i) retroactive BPT assessment at 3%-7% of recharacterized RMI-source gross revenue; (ii) statutory interest plus a 10% per month delinquency penalty on unreported amounts; (iii) revocation of the non-resident domestic declaration and tax-exempt status; (iv) suspension or revocation of the Business License and corporate certificate by the Registrar of Corporations; (v) director liability and fines for false declarations under the BPT Act; and (vi) no separate export-zero-rating clawback regime applies because the RMI administers no export VAT refund or input credit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The U.S. dollar is the legal tender. Banking and money transmission licensing/supervision is administered by the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility with no exchange control legislation. Capital account and current account transactions are unrestricted. The U.S. dollar circulates domestically, so inward capital injections, trade settlements, dividend distributions, shareholder loan repayments, and liquidation proceeds can be remitted freely without central bank approval. Non-resident Business Corporations are generally exempt from RMI income and withholding taxes, and there are no statutory profit remittance hurdles. Practical hurdles are limited to commercial bank compliance, OFAC/sanctions screening, source-of-funds documentation, and correspondent bank due diligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirements, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no prescribed repatriation timeline. Export proceeds of raw centrifugal cane sugar may be retained in USD or foreign-currency accounts at the exporter's discretion. If receipts are denominated in a non-USD currency, the exporter may convert freely or hold the funds offshore. The RMI imposes no foreign exchange registration requirement for export contracts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Transaction Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low / constrained. The RMI has no digital e-money institution licensing regime. A foreign fintech or EMI cannot independently obtain a banking license or direct RMI clearing membership. Such an entity may only operate through a partnership or sponsor arrangement with a licensed RMI commercial bank or a registered money transmitter, and all fund movements remain subject to the Money Laundering Prevention Act and the correspondent banking compliance standards of the U.S. clearing banks. Offshore EMIs face significant onboarding and de-risking challenges in this jurisdiction.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person identification is generally mandated by the locally licensed commercial banks. Natural-person directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners are normally expected to attend an interview at the bank branch in Majuro or with an approved foreign relationship manager; pure remote account opening is not guaranteed and is accepted only on a case-by-case basis with notarized and apostilled original documents, enhanced due diligence, and live video verification. A non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a licensed registered agent in the RMI and provide board resolutions, certified corporate documents, and full beneficial ownership disclosure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporation with no local employees, no physical office, and tax-optimized structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide current RMI Business Corporations Act registration certificate, certificate of good standing, registered agent acknowledgement, apostilled memorandum and articles, board resolution authorizing account opening, certified register of directors and shareholders, and a credible commercial narrative evidencing sugar commodity trading operations including charter or sale/purchase agreements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity through multi-layer offshore shareholding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete ownership cascade down to natural persons, certified register of shares, ownership declaration forms, passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, proof of residential address, bank and professional references, source of wealth statement, and source of funds documentation covering the capital to be injected.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border raw cane sugar trade involving multiple jurisdictions and potential sanctions exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed supply and sales contracts, proforma and final commercial invoices, original or telex bills of lading, SGS or equivalent certificate of analysis showing polarization, moisture and ash content, cargo surveyor report, vessel name and IMO number, vessel flag, charter party if applicable, and counterparty OFAC/EU/UN screening results.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital contribution from a related offshore entity or shareholder loan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide shareholder resolution approving the capital injection, executed capital contribution agreement or shareholder loan agreement including interest and repayment schedule, 6–12 months of source bank statements, consolidated financial statements of the investing entity, tax and corporate registry extracts, and a confirmation letter identifying final beneficial owners and the economic substance rationale for routing through the RMI BC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value wire payment to a third-country supplier or trade intermediary requesting quick disbursement without adequate documents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide final commercial invoice, purchase order, inspection certificate, full bill of lading or delivery evidence, LC or SWIFT instruction authorizing payment, counterparty bank details, contractual reimbursement clause, and a legal opinion from trade counsel where the payment pattern deviates from standard sugar commodity practice.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all capital injections as USD SWIFT MT103 wires from the originating shareholder's regulated bank to the RMI BC's operating account at a Tier 1 RMI licensed bank via the U.S. correspondent clearing network (Fedwire/CHIPS). Remittance instruction must clearly state 'CAPITAL INJECTION – MH_BC' and, where possible, use ISO 20022 purpose code 'INVS' or the bank-specific equity contribution code. No RMI exchange-control approval is required. For amounts exceeding USD 100,000, prepare board and shareholder resolutions, source-of-funds account statements, certificate of good standing, proof of ultimate beneficial ownership, and any available audited financial statements to satisfy correspondent bank and OFAC due diligence.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for open-account payments to sugar suppliers, with corresponding commercial invoice and shipping documentation, and use MT202 COV for interbank settlement. For physical VHP raw cane sugar shipments, the preferred rail is a Revolving Documentary Letter of Credit issued by the RMI bank via SWIFT MT700, subject to UCP600, with payment at sight or by deferred usance; the LC must require presentation of commercial invoice, full set of clean on-board bills of lading, SGS or equivalent certificate of analysis showing polarization, moisture and ash, phytosanitary certificate, weight certificate, and cargo survey report. Where the counterparty accepts documentary collections, DP/DA instructions may be used, but SWIFT wire remains the final clearing mechanism. All outbound wires must include precise trade references and be fully supported by underlying commodity trade contracts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards booked offshore in USD against BRL, THB, EUR, or other settlement currencies
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or less liquid emerging market currencies
FX swaps and cross-currency basis swaps used to hedge the underlying sugar import/export exposure
Vanilla FX options, zero-cost collars, and risk reversals executed with a licensed international bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report / Statement of Status of the Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 15 months of the date of incorporation and annually thereafter by the anniversary of the filing of the Articles of Incorporation; a 60-day grace period is not applied administratively unless expressly granted by the Registrar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 200 plus USD 20 per month or fraction of a month until filed; failure to cure within 90 days of the delinquency notice permits administrative administrative strike-off from the Corporate Register and loss of authority to sue in RMI courts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the same date as the Annual Corporate Report; confirmation must be delivered after the close of the preceding fiscal year and before the annual report anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fee is invoiced for this notice; however, failure to update the registered agent and office details and to confirm them with the Registrar disqualifies the good standing status and triggers the same late penalty and strike-off timeline as the Annual Corporate Report.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A non-resident Business Corporation that is not a public issuer under Part IV of the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act is not required to file audited financial statements with the Registrar. An independent audit becomes mandatory only if the corporation is registered as an issuer, if the Articles of Incorporation or a shareholders agreement imposes an audit, or if shareholders holding at least 10% of the outstanding voting shares deliver a written demand for an audit under the statutory inspection procedure.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is the primary financial reporting framework for statutory or investor-directed financial statements; US GAAP is also accepted by RMI registered agents and commercial banks for non-resident commodity trading holding companies that are not issuers.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must maintain a non-public beneficial ownership record. Each year the Business Corporation must deliver a written confirmation listing the current ultimate beneficial owners and disclosing every share transfer or membership interest transfer effected in the preceding 12 months. The confirmation is retained by the registered agent for anti-money-laundering compliance; it is not filed as part of the public Corporate Register and is not publicly accessible.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 850 - 1,750 per year for a licensed registered agent and registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, including annual report calendar management and UBO record maintenance.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - 15,000 for a certified IFRS or US GAAP audit of a non-public wholesale sugar trading corporation with bank-grade financial statements and low-volume transaction flows.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% (flat rate under the Marshall Islands Income Tax Act, applied only to income from sources within the Republic; effective rate 0% for a non-resident Business Corporation with no domestic-source income)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax-exempt zone classification for non-resident BCs: 0% effective corporate income tax on international wholesale sugar arbitrage profit (territorial source principle); no capital gains tax; no alternative minimum tax; no VAT/GST/sales tax; no branch profits tax; no payroll or social tax on non-resident employees; exemption from the Business License Act for activities conducted entirely outside the Republic; no withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties paid to non-residents; unlimited accumulation of US dollar capital and reserves with no exchange controls.
